comparator.name: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The current curriculum is represented by its 45 separately credited compulsory study units totaling 150 EC, rather than ten opaque 15-EC parent labels. Genuine integrated project and academic-skills units remain intact; parents and children are never stacked. The third year preserves two generic 15-EC minor slots, Production Systems Engineering and the 12-EC research assignment plus 3-EC societal embedding. Comprehensive re-audit 18 October 2026 independently confirms the current-student 2026–2027 table and 10 July 2026 PDF: 45 separately credited compulsory units/150 EC and two 15-EC minor positions. The 4-EC and 1-EC mechanical-tool project positions are successive credited parts in modules 1/2, not duplicate parents. The general Enschede target is not the distinct Amsterdam offering. No named specialisation is imposed on the minor. Current course pages corroborate physical prototyping/testing, engineering system modelling, polymer-product engineering and energy-system thermodynamic/material analysis. An older 2.5-EC preparatory-skills reference embedded in the research-course narrative does not override the current explicit 3.5-EC unit table. The previous 24-course UCR composition and all original evidence are preserved byte-for-byte in the dated review history; its schedule feasibility survives but its target-comparability judgment is withdrawn.

programmes.label: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering at University of Twente

exception.reason: The tested UCR composition has real product-design, robot-kinematics, linear-systems and sustainable-energy connections, but it does not sustain the target’s inquiry into the physical behaviour and engineering design of mechanical systems. Its mathematical/computational and environmental strands do not establish the mechanics, thermal-fluid, material/manufacturing analysis and repeated integration of these into engineering projects. Coherence as computational systems and sustainable technology is insufficient to establish comparability to this Mechanical Engineering target. This is a substantive target-level judgment, not a requirement for degree equivalence or a numerical matching threshold.
exception.curriculumContext: Complete independently checked 47-component/180-EC 2026–2027 Enschede curriculum retained, including 45 separate compulsory units/150 EC, two 15-EC approved minor positions, and the 12-EC research plus 3-EC societal-embedding assignment. No unresolved external-curriculum blocker.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Read all 24 selected courses against current enriched workbook c2bcc3b63ec7831fd0f7b8ddfb32de1260521655; screened all 151 identities and content leads, then examined plausible energy, water, project, software and reinforcement-learning additions. Consumer Product Design explicitly includes working-mechanism models, laboratory experiments, prototypes and industrial-scale production considerations: it is a real engineering-design contribution. Robotics includes manipulator forward/inverse kinematics and motion planning: genuine mechanical-system connections, not generic AI alone. Linear Systems has a genuine engineering connection: description2 explicitly includes differential equations, transfer functions, state-space and signal-flow with control/modelling applications; its outline-derived profile instead details LTI, convolution and Fourier/Laplace/Z transforms. The broader stated coverage is granted in the strongest positive argument, rather than treating an omission in the profile as proof of absence. Renewable System Design adds technical/economic energy-use assessment, not the target’s thermodynamic cycle/material analysis. Sustainability Essentials I has a planetary-boundary profile but a broader physics/chemistry/materials/mathematics summary; that difference is recorded rather than silently resolving it against comparability. Even granting the broader foundation, it does not establish the engineering depth/application needed by the whole composition. Essentials II teaches waves, chemistry and materials, but does not document constitutive/thermal/mechanical design. General algorithms, statistical learning and mathematical tools support the broadened computational concept but do not require/document their application to physical force, deformation, heat, flow, manufacture and integrated mechanical design. Energy & Sustainability strengthens technology/resource assessment; Reinforcement Learning strengthens autonomous computation; the sustainable-delta project does not guarantee an engineering brief or supervisor. None establishes a bounded repair of the missing physical engineering inquiry. No invented minor content, independent-research supervision or workshop sequence supplies the missing foundation. The preserved nine partial shared rows and additional robotics links are evidence to weigh, not a count threshold.

candidateAssessment.concept: Physical structures, mechanical design, materials and manufacturing
candidateAssessment.assessment: BENENTR111 provides a genuine design/prototype episode and DISDATA312 actual robot kinematics. These do not form sustained force/deformation/material/manufacturing inquiry; advanced maths and coding do not establish that taught application. No suitable bounded substitution in the current catalogue supplies it.

ENSSUST211/311, life-cycle analysis, materials/chemistry and circular-resource courses support real energy/environmental technology study, but do not establish the physical thermodynamic/thermal-fluid analysis and redesign central to the target. It is not rejected merely for lacking the same degree title or qualification.

audience.programmeDescription: Mechanical Engineering at the University of Twente studies how physical machines, structures and energy systems work and how to design and improve them. Mathematics, mechanics, thermodynamics, materials and manufacturing are applied in successive engineering projects. The Enschede curriculum includes 30 EC of minor choices and a final research assignment with a separate reflection on its societal implications.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers relevant study in product design, robot computation, mathematics and sustainable technology. These connections do not provide a sufficiently sustained programme in analysing and designing physical mechanical systems. The mechanics, heat and fluid science, materials and manufacturing integrated through Twente’s engineering projects remain substantial gaps. We therefore show Twente’s complete curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a comparable alternative.

curriculum.routeLabel: Enschede; standard curriculum with minor choices
curriculum.limitation: The two 15-EC minor positions preserve approved choice; no particular minor is assumed. The final assignment comprises 12 EC of research and 3 EC on societal implications.
